narrative.overview: The student's term is a transit network. Each subject or category is a coloured line, each deadline a station, and "ahora" a marker moving along the line. The system is a signage voice on a cool navy-tinged ground: flat panels split by hairlines, condensed tabular numerals for times, square route badges, dots on a 3px line. Density is phone-first and one-handed. Light and dark grounds both ship. State is carried by shape as well as colour. Recorded deviations: dark ground is #0a111f not the contract's #0E1626; Home uses a vertical station rail instead of the horizontal Day Line; Agenda, Grades and Radar render pre-existing mock data.
keyCharacteristics: Flat panels with 1px hairlines; no shadows, no gradients, no icon tiles.
Coral is the principal line and the only action colour; blue, green, violet, amber are route colours.
Barlow Condensed for headings, times and route codes; Barlow for everything else.
Light and dark themes via semantic tokens; dark follows the system or data-theme.

rules.name: The One Line Rule
rules.body: Coral is the only action colour. Route colours mark category and status, never buttons.

rules.name: The Ink Tier Rule
rules.body: Coloured text uses the -ink tier, coloured fills use the solid or -wash tier; never solid route hues for small text.

rules.name: The Departure Board Rule
rules.body: Times, dates and counts use condensed tabular numerals (.num).

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Separate with a 1px line border, never a shadow.

dos: Do use semantic tokens (bg-card, text-ink-2, border-line) so both themes work.
Do carry status by shape (hollow, filled, dashed; bar count) as well as colour.
Do keep touch targets at 44px and text at 13px or above.
Do separate with hairlines and tonal steps; keep exits faster than entrances.
Do use condensed tabular numerals for times, dates and counts.
donts: Don't add box shadows or gradients.
Don't use coloured icon tiles or stacks of identical rounded white cards.
Don't use emoji or decorative glyphs for state or empty views.
Don't use solid route hues for small text; use the -ink tier.
Don't hardcode hex in components except the user-chosen category colours.
